invalid_choice_text: Wren waits. Choose one of the options.

options.title: Dad brought you today.
narrative_lines: Isla: Dad brought you today.
She nods once.
Wren: He had a job. A far one.

options.title: Wait.
narrative_lines: You wait. The filter in the fish tank hums. Wren counts the stones in the tank under her breath, up to four, and stops.
Wren: Dad's got a job. It's far.

options.title: What's different about today?
narrative_lines: Isla: What's different about today?
Wren: Nothing.
She zips Rabbit's bag a second time.

options.title: That's okay. We can still start.
narrative_lines: Isla: That's okay. We can still start.
Wren: Okay.
She looks down at her shoes and says nothing else.

invalid_choice_text: Wren is busy with the bins. Choose one of the options.

options.title: Those ones live here.
narrative_lines: Isla: Those ones live here.
Wren: And those ones.
She puts the pig in the left bin, next to the cow.

options.title: Hold the small horse over the bins.
narrative_lines: You pick up the small horse and hold him over the two bins. You don't put him down.
Wren: Left. Horses go left.
She doesn't look up.

options.title: Sit on the floor and watch.
narrative_lines: You sit on the floor by the rug, facing the shelf and not her. Wren counts the animals as they go in, and gets to five.
Wren: Five live here.

options.title: Why do they live there?
narrative_lines: Isla: Why do they live there?
Wren: Because.
She takes the cow out and puts it back in the other bin.
